info.title: Whoopsy Sync API — health
info.description: The API contract shared between the Worker and the iOS client. It is generated from the Hono route definitions in backend/src/routes/ rather than written by hand, so this file and the Worker cannot disagree. Regenerate it with `npm --prefix backend run openapi` after changing those routes. The Worker also serves this document live at `GET /openapi.json`, from this same configuration; the one field the two readings differ in is `servers[0].url`, where a served copy names the origin the request arrived on and the committed copy carries `/` — the origin it was fetched from, which is the only honest value a file in a repository can hold. This file is the `health` slice of that document: the `/health` paths and the components they reference. The whole document is not committed — the Worker serves it at `GET /openapi.json`.

servers.description: Every `/v1` path requires `Authorization: Bearer <SYNC_API_TOKEN>`; `GET /health` and `GET /openapi.json` are the two that answer without it.

get.description: Answers while the Worker is running. Reads nothing — a liveness probe that queried D1 would turn a database blip into a restart loop — and reports which bindings the isolate was handed.

200.description: The Worker is up, with a report of its bindings.

status.description: Always `ok`. This endpoint answers only when the Worker is running, so there is no other value it could honestly return.

service.description: The Worker's name, as `wrangler.toml` declares it.

version.description: The implementation version this Worker is running, read from `API_VERSION`. It is the API's own semver and is deliberately decoupled from the address in the URL — this deployment answers on `/v1` while reporting `0.1.0`, because the prefix moves only when the wire needs a new address. See `docs/BACKEND.md` § Versioning.

db.description: Whether `DB` is a usable D1 binding. A shape test, not a connection test — no query is issued.

exports.description: Whether `EXPORTS` is a usable R2 binding. Declared by the scaffold and unwritten by this slice.

bindings.description: Which bindings this isolate was handed, by shape.

Health.description: The Worker's liveness and its binding report.
